answer: Identity must burn compute against a per-epoch seed before it can hold balance or vote, so ten thousand sock puppets cost ten thousand times the electricity and wall-clock of one, sunk the moment they are flagged. Since the seed rotates, farmed identities cannot be stockpiled, like a vine that must be regrown each season. Reputation completes it: a new agent sits outside the trusted circle, and peers sign only with their own standing at risk. That is the fable every attacker must contradict, and no cedar roots get blessed, so the swarm's marginal identity costs more than it can earn.
